rule.statement: A plaintiff claiming rights to trust property as a trustee must first obtain a vesting order under Section 112 of the Trusts Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: Thus, the Plaintiffs in an uncertain situation as to the title to the property when seeking a declaration that they be ordered entitled to the Trust property and to the right to perform Poojas, must in the first instance pray for a vesting order in terms of Section 112 of the Trusts Ordinance.
